description: This file defines the NavigationBuilder class used for constructing and managing navigation menus, including adding, removing, and building menu items, with support for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: NavigationBuilder
classes.description: A class for building and managing navigation menus, supporting addition, removal, and construction of menu items.

methods.name: NavigationBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the list of contained menu items.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a menu item with a caption, position, and item builder callback, supporting optional classes and priority.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a menu item with a caption, position, and item builder callback, supporting optional classes and priority.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific MenuItem from the navigation.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes menu items matching a predicate recursively.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds and returns the list of menu items.
